title: Term Positions in a Block Code
statement: Let $B$ be a switching block code of length $w$, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ variables, and suppose the width of $T$ is at most $w$. The term positions are the positions in $T$ whose images among the first $w$ positions belong to the position set of $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A switching block code of length $w$
